predictions: Seems like I'm already settling in to a predictable pattern here. A second consecutive 17-8 week, with lots of the incorrect picks coming in the bottom half of the league (with a particularly sad 1-5 record in F division so far). That of course brings me to 34-16 to this point, which keeps me at exactly 68% correct. Pretty happy with my 22-4 record in A through D divisions, but being 12-12 in E through H divisions is a bit sad. How about you guys help me out here, and just go ahead and do what I write?

Match of the week: (F Div.) One Time @ Rippin Darts. The F standings are kind of, shall we say, interesting, at the moment. A missing score, an almost certain penalty, and now one of the oddest-looking standings sets hands us this pairing of undefeateds. I don't really know what One Time has at the moment, but I think they're about to add a win to it, 14-10.

Match #2: (G Div.) We're Sexy & We Throw It @ Sharky's Machine. Both of these teams have had a bye already, so they've only played once each. But that doesn't change the fact that this is two of the three remaining squads in G. They've each faced the same team, and now one of them gets an early shot to be a G race leader. It's the Machine, 14-10.

Match #3: (D Div.) Area 501 @ One Armed Bandits. The two 2-0 teams in D each face one of the pack of 1-1 challengers this week. This could become a very crazy race, or it could become a couple teams running and hiding from the others. At least in the case of this matchup, I'm going with the leader running and hiding a bit. Area 501 rolls on, 15-9.

Match #4: (G Div.) Aim For Fame @ Nein Mark. Two teams that very likely think they are/were G contenders each already sit with a loss here. Now one of them is going to be sitting with a losing record after three weeks. Tough call, but I think Nein Mark is ready to rebound, 14-10.

Match #5: (F Div.) Shark Shooters @ Runs with Corks. I've already been warned by someone who shall remain nameless (might rhyme with Bee Man Gleaner) that I'm a fool every time I pick against the Corks. Who am I to argue, right? Let's Run with the Corks tonight, 14-10.
Match #6: (D Div.) Menace 2 Sobriety @ Shooter McGavin. The other half of the D-leader-facing-a-1-1-team story is this one. But in this one, I'll take the team with a loss already. McGavin, 13-11.
Match #7: (E Div.) Ton 80 Proof @ Point of Attack. Ton 80 has had two really different weeks so far, while Point of Attack has won big twice. I think Point wins again, but by less this time, 15-9.

Matches #8 & #9: (H Div.) Bangin the Wire @ Bright Side of Flights; 21 Dart Salute @ Double Vision. The two undefeated H teams each face a one-loss team, just like the D stories above. But unlike in D, I think both 2-0 H teams reach 3-0. I'll take Bangin by a solid 16-8 edge; and Salute just barely edges past the Vision, 13-11.
Match #10: (A Div.) The Hunted Element @ Dart Attack. Attack couldn’t repeat their wk01 magic in wk02, but they get another shot at a big win tonight. I have to stick with my Element though, 16-8.

Match #11: (B Div.) Buffalo Bulls @ Projectile Dysfunction. This is another pair of very capable one-loss teams trying not to fall too far off the pace. Early elimination match? I'll take Buffalo, 13-11.
Match #12: (F Div.) Cary On Our Wayward Darts @ Cheap Shots. It's an early version of one of those matches guaranteed to produce a first-time winner. Will this be affected by absences? Cheap, 13-11.
